_note: Expected outcomes written BEFORE any rules, by reading the real clause text (CUAD contracts in data/curated/cuad, EDGAR credit agreements in data/raw/edgar). NOT reviewed by a lawyer. 'us' = the party the event happens to. Ownership events are given as the cap table AFTER the event. Day convention for 'N years from D': ends on D + N years - 1 day; 'at least X days prior to expiry' = last notice day is expiry - X days. Statuses: TRIGGERED / NOT_TRIGGERED / NEEDS_LAWYER.
